Recent Gowans PIECE/SLAB OF MACROCARPA lots mostly hammer $20 to $55, best wide slab $115. Generic timber lot so stopped early. eBay sold would add little.
viewing_check: Measure length, width and thickness; check crack length and whether it runs through, and knots/bark inclusions. Confirm species and that it is dry (not green, no borer). Wider than 400 mm and clean is worth the higher hammers (about $100+); a cracked narrow piece is the $30 to $55 type.
